name: COG Financial Services Limited
summary: COG Financial Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a finance broker aggregator in Australia. The company operates through Salary Packaging, Broking & Aggregation, and Lending segments. It offers novated leasing and salary packaging services to government and private sector customers; financing arrangements to commercial customers for essential business assets and the management of investment funds; car and equipment finance aggregation; and processing services to mortgage brokers.
